scope: Section 19 of the owner's Objective 05 authorization.

criteria.criterion: All seven new modules are implemented.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os sete novos módulos estiverem implementados.
criteria.observed: Each workspace has a Rust or WASM contract, interface and module-specific evidence.

criteria.criterion: All 22 modules are integrated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os 22 módulos estiverem integrados.
criteria.observed: The local production inventory contains Standard and 21 isolated tool WASM binaries. The browser proof matrix covers all 22.

criteria.criterion: Scientific results are independently validated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os resultados científicos estiverem validados.
criteria.observed: Independent mathematical references, adversarial cases and explicit tolerances are retained by suite.

criteria.criterion: Statistical conventions are documented.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: As convenções estatísticas estiverem documentadas.
criteria.observed: Sample and population conventions, quantiles, rank behavior, assumptions and limitations are stated.

criteria.criterion: Probability distributions are independently verified.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: As distribuições probabilísticas estiverem verificadas.
criteria.observed: All 17 families, mass or density, tails, interval probabilities, quantiles and samples were checked.

criteria.criterion: Simulations reproduce results according to their contracts.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: As simulações forem reproduzíveis conforme seus contratos.
criteria.observed: Fixed-seed paths and 36 batch replays were checked. Decimal VaR ranks and representable loss are exercised by independent cases.

criteria.criterion: Optimization algorithms report convergence and limitations accurately.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os algoritmos de otimização informarem convergência e limitações corretamente.
criteria.observed: Brackets, residual, stopping reason and iteration controls are tested. Local optima and exact linear outcomes retain separate meanings.

criteria.criterion: Physical quantities respect units and dimensions.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: As grandezas físicas respeitarem unidades e dimensões.
criteria.observed: Dimensional checks include incompatible units and the 12 V/6 Ω case with 2 A and 24 W.

criteria.criterion: Graph Lab works in 2D and 3D within its validated scope.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O Graph Lab estiver funcional em 2D e 3D dentro do escopo validado.
criteria.observed: Observed 2D discontinuity gaps, 3D rendering, keyboard inspection and local export. Recovery uses synthetic Canvas context events.

criteria.criterion: Data Lab imports and transforms the prescribed data formats.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O Data Lab importar e transformar os formatos definidos.
criteria.observed: CSV, TSV, tabular JSON and XLSX, explicit typing and structured replay are exercised.

criteria.criterion: File import is secure within the audited scope.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A importação de arquivos for segura.
criteria.observed: Malformed and oversized archives, relationship paths, XML, cell limits and formula-safe export are exercised locally.

criteria.criterion: Long-running calculations can be cancelled.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os cálculos prolongados forem canceláveis.
criteria.observed: Browser runs exercise cancellation and subsequent work for Simulation, Optimization and Data Lab. The WASM task checks independent batch disposal.

criteria.criterion: The task manager recovers after faults and cancellation.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O gerenciador de tarefas permanecer recuperável.
criteria.observed: Inherited timeout and recovery tests plus scientific worker cancellation verify successful successors.

criteria.criterion: Scientific Calculation Proof is integrated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O Calculation Proof científico estiver integrado.
criteria.observed: Proofs preserve mathematical conventions, source notation, model parameters and manifest bindings in their applicable workspaces.

criteria.criterion: All five adaptive profiles remain functional.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os cinco perfis adaptativos permanecerem funcionais.
criteria.observed: The browser report exercises all five Graph Lab profiles with one immutable proof digest. Inherited worker tests cover scheduling under five profiles.

criteria.criterion: All seven supported languages are validated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os sete idiomas estiverem validados.
criteria.observed: Final Chrome includes the seven-locale scientific label check, including Arabic RTL.

criteria.criterion: The full 924-comparison locale matrix is verified.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A matriz de 924 comparações estiver verificada.
criteria.observed: The verified candidate matrix contains 420 mathematical, 210 financial and 294 scientific comparisons across 42 directed pairs.

criteria.criterion: Offline operation is demonstrated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O funcionamento offline estiver comprovado.
criteria.observed: Production Chrome and physical Windows calculated in all seven science workspaces offline. The standalone web and physical Windows financial offline cases also passed.

criteria.criterion: The inherited regression suites pass.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: As regressões anteriores estiverem aprovadas.
criteria.observed: The 578 mapped local checks are complemented by 17 physical Windows WebView2 checks, two hosted credential checks and five hosted capability tests. The approved regression corpus is retained.

criteria.criterion: Benchmarks are published on the review branch.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os benchmarks estiverem publicados.
criteria.observed: The review evidence includes local WASM, native Simulation and Data Lab volume results, a paired physical Windows benchmark and the sampled Price comparison.

criteria.criterion: The outstanding memory measurement debt is updated.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A dívida de memória estiver atualizada.
criteria.observed: The updated debt record includes paired 0.4.1/0.5.0 observations. Attribution of less than 100 MB incremental physical RAM remains open.

criteria.criterion: Security and privacy controls are preserved.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A segurança e a privacidade estiverem preservadas.
criteria.observed: The exact-source security job succeeded, and physical/offline checks preserved the local execution and Windows policy scope. Inherited informational Rust advisories remain listed.

criteria.criterion: The Windows executable functions on a physical device.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O aplicativo Windows estiver funcional.
criteria.observed: Physical WebView2 executed seven offline science modules, three Graph Lab/Data Lab cycles, 17 inherited desktop checks, five offline finance examples and the comparator replay. All 22 hosted WASM assets were read back.

criteria.criterion: The web build works in a production browser.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A versão web estiver funcional.
criteria.observed: The final review source passed 224 local Chrome tests on the production asset set and 224 hosted Ubuntu Chromium tests.

criteria.criterion: All four GitHub Actions jobs pass for the verified source.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: Os quatro jobs do GitHub Actions estiverem aprovados.
criteria.observed: The exact source passed Ubuntu, Windows, macOS and security on workflow run 45860076452.

criteria.criterion: English and Brazilian Portuguese documentation is current.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: A documentação bilíngue estiver atualizada.
criteria.observed: Module reports, methods, scope and reproduction are recorded in both languages.

criteria.criterion: Audited code and evidence are published on the review branch.
criteria.criterion_pt_BR: O código e as evidências estiverem publicados.
criteria.observed: The audited source is public on the dedicated review branch. This evidence pack accompanies that branch delivery. The final Git evidence head is checked externally to the pack.

rust_source_equivalence.method: Git tree comparison between source snapshots
